paragraphs.text: Sulgh (SOOLG), also known as the Sulgh Swamp and the Great Sulgh Salt Marsh is a region on the Dominarian continent of Corondor .

Sulgh forms the southwestern half of the Great Salt Marshes of Western Golthonor , bordered to the north and east by the other great salt marsh, Khone . To the south lies the ocean, and to the west runs the Golthonor Torrent , forming the border with Casindral , with Shikar on the far side.

Sulgh was also where Sivitri Scarzam began Sivitri's War , starting with her invasion of Scarzam Dragons . After Sivitri fled the plane, Geyadrone Dihada began her conquest of the area, eventually coming to rule all of southern Corondor . Dihada too left Dominaria , and left the corrupted Force of Nature named Sol'Kanar the Swamp King to rule in her stead.

Situated between Shikar and Khone , Sulgh became the dominion of Sol'Kanar the Swamp King for millennia. From there, he terrorized the two Contrary Kingdoms , destroying their trade routes and killing their people, forcing them to give him a Date of Tribute until the Dragon War weakened him severely, and Chondaeh killed everyone in Khone but Gydolien Mor . Sol'Kanar crawled off to recuperate, biding his time, while Shikar bloomed as a nation, and Gydolien plotted her vengeance.

Thousands of years later, Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion found Altair of Coloni and Caliphear the Nightmare in Sulgh and formed a pact with them shortly before the Activation of the Mox Beacon .
